generator._: How finely each level is cut (an edge's points no further apart than nearM within nearEyeM of the corner's cameras, farM beyond), whether it keeps the shed plates (spall), its first ring's inset from the edge (insetM: a joint's dark margin that narrow), its triangle budget (each level at most 60 % of the one before), and the contact shade baked into the sky term (the foot darkest where the rock goes into the ground, to footDark over footM; a joint's margin to jointDark over jointM).
